key.name: move-panel-to-bottom
key.summary: Move the top bar to the bottom of the screen
key.description: When off, the panel stays where the shell placed it. Ordering still applies.

key.name: hide-activities
key.description: Remove Activities from the panel layout.

key.name: disable-panel-window-drag
key.summary: Stop pressing the panel from starting a window drag
key.description: When off, restore the stock shell behaviour: press on the panel with a maximized window behind it and the window is grabbed.

key.name: date-menu-position
key.summary: Where to move the date/clock menu
key.description: stock: leave it in the shell's default position. *-first: remove it from every box and put it first in that box.
